title: External-duality comparison respects open composition of a support map
statement:
Fix the coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $A=A_{E,n}$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Work in the finite-Tor constructible categories $D^b_{ctf}(-,A)$ with the canonical ordinary and exceptional adjunctions and composition comparisons of [def-trf-admissibility]. Let $X,C$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $c=(c_1,c_2):C\to Z=X\times_sX$ a correspondence [def-trf-correspondence], $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$, and $j:W\hookrightarrow C$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $P=K\boxtimes_A^L D_XK$ using [def-trf-external-product, def-trf-dualizing-complex], and put $H_c=R\mathcal Hom_A(Lc_2^*K,Rc_1^!K)$ and $H_{cj}=R\mathcal Hom_A(L(c_2j)^*K,R(c_1j)^!K)$ [def-trf-trace-class-source]. The pullback and exceptional composition comparisons identify $H_{cj}$ with $R\mathcal Hom_A(Lj^*Lc_2^*K,Rj^!Rc_1^!K)$. Denote the exceptional internal-Hom exchange of [lem-trf-exceptional-internal-hom-exchange] under this identification by $E_j:H_{cj}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rj^!H_c$. Let $\xi_c:H_c\xrightarrow{\sim}Rc^!P$ and $\xi_{cj}:H_{cj}\xrightarrow{\sim}R(cj)^!P$ be the external-duality comparisons of [thm-trf-verdier-duality], with the same external product order. If $\kappa:R(cj)^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rj^!Rc^!$ is the specified composition comparison, then
$$\kappa_P\circ\xi_{cj}=Rj^!(\xi_c)\circ E_j.$$
This is equality of the canonical maps, with no additional symmetry permutation or sign.

source.place: §0.3(a)-(b), equations (0.3)-(0.4), and §1.2.2(a), first arrow: compatibility with open composition.
